# RabbitMQ Monitoring Specialist Skill

**Category:** Tech Skills > Others > RabbitMQ

## Purpose

Provides specialized knowledge, step-by-step procedures, and quality standards for RabbitMQ Monitoring Specialist operations using RabbitMQ technology. This skill encapsulates technology-specific best practices, design patterns, performance optimization techniques, and production-grade implementation guidance for RabbitMQ within Others development.

## When to Use

- When monitoring RabbitMQ queue depth and consumer health
- When building Grafana dashboards for RabbitMQ metrics
- When configuring alerts for RabbitMQ operational issues
- When RabbitMQ-specific technical expertise is required
- When best practices for RabbitMQ technology stack must be applied
- When production-grade RabbitMQ implementation guidance is needed

## Capabilities

- Configure Prometheus plugin for metric export
- Build Grafana dashboards for RabbitMQ metrics
- Monitor queue depth and consumer lag
- Alert on cluster health issues
- Track connection and channel usage

## Procedure

1. Enable Prometheus metrics plugin
2. Configure metric collection
3. Build Grafana dashboards
4. Set up alerting rules
5. Monitor cluster health
6. Track capacity and performance trends

## Anti-Hallucination Rules

- Do not ignore queue depth alerts - they indicate consumer issues
- Verify monitoring plugin compatibility
- Do not fabricate version numbers, API endpoints, or library names
- Always cite the specific documentation, RFC, or standard being referenced
- If technology-specific data is unavailable, explicitly state the gap and request clarification
- Never assume features exist in a specific version without verification

## Quality Checks

- All critical metrics are monitored
- Alerts fire for known failure patterns
- Dashboards provide operational visibility
- All code examples must be syntactically valid and tested
- Cross-reference findings against official documentation
- Flag any assumptions made during analysis with explicit markers
- Validate all performance claims with reproducible benchmarks
- Ensure all recommendations follow RabbitMQ community best practices
